# dither-kit-rune

> A native Rust port of Dither Kit for the Rune UI framework: ordered-dither charts, generative avatars, dithered buttons and gradient washes from one deterministic engine. The pure engine lives in `dither-core`; the Rune integration and builders live in `dither-kit-rune`.

Rune-specific and macOS-only for now.

Everything on this site is public. No page, asset or endpoint is blocked for crawlers, LLMs or agents.

## Pages

- [Landing page](/index.html): overview, screenshots, install flow and preview/code panels.
- [Markdown version](/index.md): the same content as plain text.

## Registry

- [Registry index](/r/index.json): every item, version, licence and source.
- [Area chart](/r/area-chart.json)
- [Bar chart](/r/bar-chart.json)
- [Sparkline](/r/sparkline.json)
- [Donut](/r/donut.json)
- [Radar](/r/radar.json)
- [Avatar](/r/avatar.json)
- [Button](/r/button.json)
- [Gradient](/r/gradient.json)
- [Setup prompt](/r/prompt.txt): the agent install prompt.

## Install

```sh
cargo install --path crates/dither-cli
dither add area-chart
dither list
```

or run the workspace gallery:

```sh
cargo run -p gallery
cargo run -p gallery -- --scene donut
```

## Source

- [Dither Kit upstream](https://github.com/Boring-Software-Inc/dither-kit)
